Name: Happy Birthday - Vietnamese Content Pack
Author: kunilazy
Description:
A content pack that contains Vietnamese for the mod, Happy Birthday.

Installation

1. Make sure you have SMAPI downloaded.
2. Make sure you have the main mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] downloaded
3. Download this mod and extract it's contents into StardewValley/Mods folder

4. Run the game!
